name: Vengeance on the Northspring
summary: Talo Thornhoof was once a seasoned hunter who feared no creature, until harpies ambushed Talo in the forest. The hate has boiled inside ever since, and Talo asks you to take revenge on the Northspring harpies, found to the west.

sections.title: An Old Hunter's Grudge
sections.body: Talo remembers being a seasoned hunter who feared nothing that lived. Then came a day in the forest, honing a weapon once a hard fight was over, when harpies surrounded Talo. Talo barely dragged to safety, still hears their cries echoing, and was never the same afterward. All this time later the hate still boils, and Talo wants revenge.

sections.title: The Northspring Harpies
sections.body: The Northspring harpies live to the west. Talo wants four each of the Northspring Harpies, Roguefeathers, Windcallers and Slayers dead. Their wings are black as night, Talo warns, and they can slip out of sight into the darkness.

sections.title: After the Hunt
sections.body: Talo, speaking as an old tauren, thanks you and says you have put a troubled mind at peace.

aliases: who gives vengeance on the northspring
faq.answer: A seasoned hunter in days past, who feared no creature until harpies ambushed Talo in the forest. Talo was never the same afterward.

faq.q: Where are the Northspring harpies located?
faq.answer: To the west of Talo Thornhoof.

faq.q: Why does Talo want revenge against the harpies?
faq.answer: Harpies ambushed Talo in the forest, surrounding Talo while honing a weapon after a fight, and Talo barely got away. Talo was never the same, and the hate still boils inside.

faq.q: Which harpies does Talo want killed?
faq.answer: Four each of the Northspring Harpies, Northspring Roguefeathers, Northspring Windcallers and Northspring Slayers.

faq.q: What do the Northspring harpies look like?
faq.answer: Talo says their wings are black as night, and warns that they can vanish into the darkness.
